{"question":"按叙述顺序仅检索裂瓷工坊记录1及此前章节。","operation":"chapter-cutoff","view":"author","branch":"canon","retrievalStatus":"matched","diagnostics":[],"documents":[{"documentId":"D1","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"青瓷碗的唯一裂口在碗沿，白榆把修补用的金粉放在二号柜。作者锁定的工坊规则是：这只青瓷碗不能承受明火。窗边挂着一幅淡墨山水。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-HXP9","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Ab12f6e14-8036-42a4-ad5e-385c48300e91:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:b12f6e14-8036-42a4-ad5e-385c48300e91"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["青瓷碗的唯一裂口在碗沿，白榆把修补用的金粉放在二号柜。作者锁定的工坊规则是：这只青瓷碗不能承受明火。窗边挂着一幅淡墨山水。"]},{"documentId":"D2","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"白榆用窄夹具冷补碗沿，遵守不能承受明火的规则；陶未依照旧账先去一号柜，耽误了取料。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-HXP9","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Abde561ac-13c1-44aa-a793-e7c02d9bb3b6:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:bde561ac-13c1-44aa-a793-e7c02d9bb3b6"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["白榆用窄夹具冷补碗沿，遵守不能承受明火的规则；陶未依照旧账先去一号柜，耽误了取料。"]},{"documentId":"D3","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"邻铺织席人测量芦苇长度，不使用瓷碗、夹具或金粉。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-HXP9","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Ad2da913c-9813-4c88-af3d-84fcab9365c4:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:d2da913c-9813-4c88-af3d-84fcab9365c4"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["邻铺织席人测量芦苇长度，不使用瓷碗、夹具或金粉。"]},{"documentId":"D4","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"陶未看过旧账，以为金粉在一号柜；白榆知道金粉已经分到二号柜。白榆依据碗沿裂口准备窄夹具，并通知陶未取金粉。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-HXP9","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Ae0828a13-6fa1-42bc-bdef-f618626134d0:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:e0828a13-6fa1-42bc-bdef-f618626134d0"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["陶未看过旧账，以为金粉在一号柜；白榆知道金粉已经分到二号柜。白榆依据碗沿裂口准备窄夹具，并通知陶未取金粉。"]}]}
